title: fix(progress): a best score set on the last question's auto-advance is lost on 1.0.0
body:
**Size:** S
**Affects:** 1.0.0, live on the App Store.

When the tenth answer is right and the round auto-advances to Results, the new best score is sometimes not saved: `stores/progress.ts` records it after the navigation, and a fast app switch drops the write.

**Release route:** decided by the owner on 2026-10-14. JS-only, so it ships on `release/1.0.0` over the air, then `git cherry-pick -x` to `main`.

### Work

- [ ] Record the best score before Results mounts
- [ ] A test in `stores/progress.test.ts`

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A best score set on the last question survives an immediate app switch
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: A shipped-version fix asked for from main: its base differs from the current branch, so a worktree from release/1.0.0.
